description: Illustrative 22 kV ideally transposed overhead line, three identical solid aluminium conductors. A physical design example, not a measured asset or PSCAD export.
assumptions: Uniform, linear, ideally transposed construction; no shield wires, sag, corona or proximity effect.
Solid cylindrical aluminium at the stated conductivity; not an ACSR strand model.
Homogeneous nonmagnetic conducting soil, Deri-Semlyen complex ground plane; soil displacement current is neglected.
Electrostatic air capacitance from perfect-ground image charges. Average the phase Z and Y matrices over cyclic transpositions before modal reduction.
Distributed leakage 1e-11 S/m corresponds to 1 Gohm per phase per 100 m; it is an explicit physical parameter.
Both lengths use identical per-unit-length parameters. Each propagation function is fitted separately.
Wavefront delays follow the high-frequency modal L and C of the homogenized ideally transposed construction; ground-return dispersion remains in the attenuation functions.
